en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the Grace of the divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ੧ : ਵਸਤੂ ਨ੍ਰਿਦੇਸ ਮੰਗਲ। ਮਨੁੱਖਾ ਦੇਹ ਸਫਲ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਹੈ?
verses.translit_en: 1 : vasatoo niradhes ma(n)gal| manu'khaa dheh safal kive(n) hai?

en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the Grace of the divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਧਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: oa(n)kaar akaar kar paun paanee baisa(n)tar dhaare|

en.bdb: Oankar transforming into forms created air, water and fire.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਦੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: dharat akaas vichhoRian cha(n)dh soor dhe jot savaare|

en.bdb: Then separating earth and sky He threw two flames of sun and moon in between them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: khaanee chaar ba(n)dhaan kar lakh chauraaseeh joon dhuaare|

en.bdb: Further creating the four mines of life He created eighty four lacs of species and their animalcules.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤੁ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਅਪਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: eikas ikas joon vich jeea ja(n)t anaganat apaare|

en.bdb: In each species further are born myriads of creatures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: maanas janam dhula(n)bh hai safal janam gur saran udhaare|

en.bdb: Among them all, the human birth is the rare one.  One should, in this very Birth, liberate himself by surrendering before the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh liv bhai bhagat gur giaan veechaare|

en.bdb: One must go to holy congregation; the consciousness should be merged in the word of the Guru and cultivating only a loving devotion, one should undertake to follow the path shown by the Guru.
The man by becoming altruist becomes beloved of the Guru.
